pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Verdant Essence Stone forms where the spiritual energies of water and wood intertwine. Its smooth, jade-green surface carries gentle traces of natural energy. It is most frequently encountered in damp wetlands, overgrown caves, and regions rich in vegetation.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Found in swamps, mangrove swamps, rivers, and lush caves, with starting elevations between Y −32 and 48.
